manifesto.title: When was the last time a place changed the way you see life?
manifesto.body: This is not just a property in Mahahual. It is a way of living the Caribbean: privacy, design and nature in a limited collection of residences, for those who know the difference between visiting an extraordinary place and belonging to it.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.draft: Draft pending legal review by Mexo Company.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.text: Mexo Company, developer of Grand Mayahual La Reserve, is responsible for processing your personal data. Address: to be confirmed. Contact: +52 998 704 2445.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: Name, WhatsApp or phone number, email address, layout of interest, contact preference and time, and any message you choose to write. We do not collect sensitive data.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: To contact you and follow up on your request for a presentation, brochure, Legal Pack or broker information; to send you commercial information about Grand Mayahual La Reserve; and to improve this site with aggregate statistics.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.text: With the Mexo Company sales team and with providers that host or process data on its behalf. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You may access, correct or delete your data, object to its use or withdraw your consent (ARCO rights) by writing to us on WhatsApp at +52 998 704 2445. We will reply within the periods set by law.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.text: This site may use cookies and measurement tools to understand how it is used. You can block them in your browser settings.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
sections.text: If this notice changes, we will publish the current version on this page.
